text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That BNW showdown sure was heated after 
all~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wasn't Narita Taishin amazing back 
there?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was so intense. Was it always 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: U-Uuu~~, I couldn't win~~...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (Besides, besides, Taishin somehow looks—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Taishin was running so fast, it 
completely freaked me out...!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (...What if this were the Derby?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Urk, waaaahhhhh~~!! No backing down!! 
Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEEEEERRRRRBYYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that guy?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it must have been utterly 
frustrating for them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still... I cannot afford to yield the next 
race, of all things. I must prepare 
thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I'll analyze today's share. 
...Thoroughly, that is."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, the heated race shown by BNW 
earned massive acclaim—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The number of fans longing to see them 
clash on the track once more skyrocketed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the one Winning Ticket has her 
heart set on: the Japanese Derby...!
